investigator.method: Bounded Level 1 PASSIVE_STATIC probe as part of BEATMAPPED-LONDON-SECOND-LIVE-TRANCHE-01 triage refinement: a single unauthenticated GET to the venue's official website (or official programme URL when directly given), no retries, no browser, no authentication, no challenge bypass, no state-changing request.

probe_history.reason: The retained response is a generic about/contact page with no show listing; it neither confirms nor rules out substantial music programming, so the music-relevance question remains genuinely unresolved from this bounded probe.

identity.notes: The retained response's own <title> is "About the theatre | Thameside Theatre | Thurrock Council" and its body names "Thameside Theatre... part of the Thameside Complex" at Orsett Road, Grays, RM17 5DX, matching the candidate name and address; this is a council-hosted venue page, not a separate first-party venue domain.

venue_location.notes: The retained response's own address text corroborates the candidate's discovery-supplied address, but this probe did not promote it to a canonical venue fact.

reasons: The given official_website resolves to a generic "About the theatre" council page (contact details, ticket-purchase links, technical spec PDF) with no current show/event listing in the retained response, and the given official_programme_url is only a "Conditions of ticket sales" legal page, not a programme page.

Music-relevance cannot be honestly assessed from this single bounded GET; the venue's actual current programme lives elsewhere on thurrock.gov.uk (e.g. a ticketing/what's-on page) and needs a separate, deliberate fetch before a decision either way.

evidence.description: Retained, bounded, contiguous excerpt of the actual HTTP response body from the single unauthenticated GET, plus real response metadata (status, final URL, content-type); the excerpt substring is a literal transcription of the response but is wrapped in a JSON envelope with metadata rather than the full raw byte stream, so it is not itself the byte-faithful response.
evidence.method: curl -sL; descriptive research User-Agent; 20-second timeout; redirects followed; unauthenticated GET; no retry.
